operators_published_before_rate.why: The only defer test passes --days 14 explicitly, so the argparse default bound to DEFAULT_DEFER_DAYS is never exercised.

close.main calls validate() with the default flag. The one test that mentions require_complete passes both True and False explicitly. Shipped CI is the store_true CLI flag, also default-off.
